title: A signal in the noise
description: Random letters settle into a short, readable line from left to right.
useCase: Introduce a brief technical or editorial headline. Keep essential reading outside the scramble.
reducedMotion: The final text stays visible, with no changing random characters.
limitations: The supplied uppercase Latin character set suits this English phrase. Choose a script-appropriate set for other languages.
look: Dark charcoal-green field with a pale lime monospace uppercase headline, a small letterspaced grey-green eyebrow, a thin rule, caption and replay glyph.
motion: On mount or replay, each letter shows random A–Z/0–9 characters every 40 ms and locks to its final glyph left to right over 20 steps (about 0.8 s).
adapt: The scramble is the `setInterval` effect: `steps` (20) and the 40 ms interval set duration, `characters` is the random pool, and a letter resolves once `progress * text.length > index`. Replace `text`; keep the `aria-label` and reduced-motion branch.
